rules.sequence: uppercase then T-to-U; exactly 200; ACGUN; N nucleotide/pair indicators zero; no orientation changes
rules.structure: exactly 200 symbols .(); strictly balanced; reciprocal partners; immediate nesting parent; terminal closing pair has no pair children
rules.loop_order: sort terminal pairs (i,j) by (abs((i+j)/2-99.5),i,j); retain three; pad missing records with zeros
rules.relative: offset-major -20..20 around floor((i+j)/2); channels A,C,G,U,dot,opening,closing; out-of-range all zero
rules.stem: innermost-to-outermost first 32 immediate-parent ancestors including terminal; each 22 channels in STEM order; absent rows zero
rules.stem_numeric: opening/200,closing/200,(closing-opening)/200,((opening+closing)/2-99.5)/200,(inner_open-outer_open-1)/200,(outer_close-inner_close-1)/200,maximal_contiguous_stack_length/200; innermost gaps zero; count all intervening positions even with branching
rules.stack: maximal consecutive pairs (i+k,j-k) containing this pair, not ancestor chain length
rules.preprocessing: new median SimpleImputer(keep_empty_features=True) fitted on all 48796 augmented training rows only; no scaling or selection; neural preprocessing unchanged
